summary: Installed the TypeSafe skill into the gizmo repo using `npx skills add typesafe-ai/skills --skill typesafe-ai --agent '*' -y`, which placed files at .agents/skills/typesafe-ai/, created .claude/ and agent/ directories, and wrote skills-lock.json. Verified installation via `npx skills list --json` and read the installed SKILL.md to confirm contents.
decisions: Chose the `npx skills add` installation route (over the `claude plugin` route) because the environment is a non-Claude agent (no .pi/.claude/.cursor/.codex config present initially; Claude CLI was on PATH but a non-interactive install was preferred).
Installed with `--agent '*' -y` to fan out to all 79 detected agents non-interactively rather than selecting one agent, since the active agent wasn't clearly identifiable from repo config.
